role: @Observable holder of streaming-mode and pause/resume state split out of RRCollector so views observing it do not re-render on unrelated collector changes; injected into the SwiftUI environment and read by Record views.
toplevel: Seven observable stored properties with default initialisers; no methods. Owned by RRCollector (RRCollector.swift:187, created at 703) and read through @Environment(StreamingLifecycle.self) in RecordView and passed to StreamingLiveView/RecordingStatusViews/RecordPanels.
